statement: Pinned devkitPro/libogc Wii WPAD calls the wiiuse speaker setter on connect and on WPAD_ControlSpeaker. On enable after handshake it sends mute report 0x19, enable report 0x14, writes speaker addresses A20009=01 then A20001=08, writes seven bytes starting at A20001 with format 0x00 ADPCM, little-endian rate divisor 0x07d0 and volume 0x40, writes A20008=01, unmutes with 0x19 and requests status 0x15. Disable mutes, writes A20001=01 and A20009=00, sends enable 0x14 off and requests status. Speaker state is read from status report 0x20, not inferred solely from command dispatch.

applicability.revision: Original Wii Remote consumer protocol paths; no retail revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. No host or hardware execution; speaker source-only consumer analysis; tests and proposed experiments not run. See docs/wii-speaker-consumers.md for pinned locators and bounded inferences.
